candidates.prompt: Create ONE independently designed ULTRA-WIDE 4:1 SKY PANORAMA texture, requested native image 3072x768 pixels, suitable for downsampling to 2048x512 WITHOUT upscaling or cropping. The actual output must be one continuous ultra-wide panoramic strip, not square, not 16:9, not a triptych or contact sheet. ONLY OPEN SKY AND SOFT CLOUDS / atmospheric haze, edge to edge, for a bright clean miniature Chinese fantasy game's distant sky cylinder. Absolutely NO land, terrain, sea, water, skyline, mountains, buildings, rooftops, trees, architecture, humans, animals, vehicles, lettering, border or frame. Do not depict a physical horizon line separating ground from sky; even the lower edge is sky/soft haze. HORIZONTALLY SEAMLESS 360-degree wrap: right edge continues naturally into left, at exactly the same vertical cloud/haze levels and color progression. Cloud formations that cross either side must carry on unobtrusively at the other; no lateral color gradient, dark edge bands or one-sided bright light source. Vertical top-to-bottom sky color variation is allowed; the top and bottom do NOT need to match. Keep a natural softly painted atmosphere with discernible gentle cloud silhouettes and low-frequency tonal gradients, not flat solid color bands, not a storm, not hard outlined cloud stickers. NO sun or moon discs, huge glowing orb, central sun focal point, star pattern, rays, lens flare, localized hot glow or vignette. Sun discs/scene lights belong to the game separately. Restrained luminous pastel sky, airy clear colors, no dark purple cyber-neon night. Output a single opaque RGB high-resolution 4:1 panoramic image. VARIANT1: warm PEACH AND ROSE dusk, referring to a lively sunset-market atmosphere. Upper sky a light dusty blue-lavender #969dc3, gradually turning gentle rose-pink #e6a0ab and pale peach-apricot #f4bd96 / #ffd0a5 toward the lower sky. A modest scattering of small/medium soft elongated cumulus and fine wisps in pale cream-peach and subdued rosy gray, about25-35% cloud coverage. Clear open areas between clouds, varied soft contours, no dominant giant cloud. Keep both lateral edges at the same lavender/rose/peach levels and small-cloud density, no concentrated sunlight or gradient from left to right.
